activity.overview: Read word pairs and hear the vowel change from short to long.
activity.passage: When we add Magic E to the end of a word, the vowel says its name. Listen: cap, cape. Kit, kite. Hop, hope. The first word has a short vowel. The second word has a long vowel.

questions.prompt: Read these two words: tap, tape. Which word has a long a?
Read these two words: pin, pine. Which word has a long i?
Read these two words: not, note. Which word has a long o?
Why does the vowel in cube say its name?

sentenceFrames: The vowel says its name because ___.
